purpose: Uploads picture bytes to a vault's file door with a request signed for that vault, and answers the stored file's address, or an error that keeps what the vault said.
namedChanges: 0.2.1. uploadUrl sends folder only when not empty or blank (an empty folder= is a platform 400); UploadTarget.folder is optional

U1. UploadTarget { vaultOrigin, vaultRoot, folder } replaces the app's settings; uploadUrl(filename, target) and uploadPicture(blob, filename, target); the literal plant-pictures is target.folder, now encoded
U2. imports: dpopWriteAuth, NotSignedInError, invalidateDpop from lws-session-bridge; serverReasonOrNull from lws-records; NoAccessError, VaultBusyError, refusalLine from refusal-detail

U3. the body is read once after the 401 check for every status other than 200 and 201; 403 throws NoAccessError with sentence and detail; 502/503/504 write one console.warn (refusal line and body.slice(0, 300)) and throw VaultBusyError as in the source; any other status throws PictureUploadError(status, text) with the source's message and body.slice(0, 2000)
U4. the content-type header follows the blob: blob.type when it starts with image/, else image/jpeg; for a JPEG blob the request is the 0.1.0 request

host.replaces: VAULT_ORIGIN from the app's config, src/config.ts:6, used at src/data/pictures.ts:84

library.title: Picture upload
library.note: Uploads bytes only; to make the sizes take picture-shrink, to upload and link all sizes with resume take picture-set.
